fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Narcissus and Echo in the Nexus Event", "body": "The hosts read the episode through the myth of Narcissus. Chance said the pool in a forest, and Sylvie's name meaning of the woods, tied the scene to the myth, and one of the hosts added that an older telling made Narcissus a young man mourning a twin sister. The hosts read Sif's repeated strikes and half repeated line in Loki's time loop as Echo, who could only finish the end of a sentence. Chance noted that Mobius called Loki the ultimate narcissist, and that Loki was freed from the loop once he voiced real remorse."}, {"title": "The Devil Card and the Number Seventy", "body": "Chance pointed to the Hebrew letter Ayin on the Thoth devil card, which he said meant eye and spring and carried the value 70. He then traced words he said also added up to 70, among them a word for ring or circle, the phrase Adam and Eve, a word for howling, the word for wine and a word for a secret council. Gabe, who tipped Chance off to the devil card theme, described the Thoth card flipped upside down as a mosquito and tied cards six and fifteen to his Enneagram map."}, {"title": "Crown Chakra, Cronos and the Timekeepers", "body": "Chance connected the chandelier crown over Renslayer to the crown chakra, saying the word sounded like Cron, as in Cronos, and that the topmost level of the biofield was where a person's relationship to time sat. He described a master and slave pattern in which anyone ruling others also answered to someone above, and said government had replaced God for many people. He compared that to Renslayer serving the timekeepers. Later he read the runes behind the timekeepers, including Ingwaz and Kenaz, as symbols of a cycle."}, {"title": "Constellation Toys and Twin Mountains", "body": "Gabe shared a star map that placed the toys in young Sylvie's scene where the Argo Navis and the Antlia cluster sat in the night sky, and he suggested the placement was deliberate. Chance, citing John McHugh, said the Gemini twins were twin mountains to the Mesopotamians and read the opening view of Asgard as Mount Ararat after the ark. Chance also called Loki the Ship of Theseus in reverse, with the body unchanged and the personality replaced, and Gabe replied that redemption meant replacing everything on the interior."}, {"title": "Mobius, Seven Cards and Abstinence", "body": "Gabe placed the chariot and tower cards side by side to describe Mobius as an Enneagram seven, an epicure with a shadow of gluttony, and said Mobius practiced abstinence when he skipped his second drink. One of the hosts suggested alcohol played the role of soma, keeping people pacified, so that refusing it gave Mobius a clear view of the lies around him. Chance said Mobius took the advice of the devil card when he chose to go after what he wanted despite the discomfort. Gabe also noted that Mobius and B-15 entered scenes from the left once they had a change of heart."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Forging ahead into episode 4 of Marvel's Loki TV series with cohost Slick Dissident, "The Nexus Event" installment is once again dripping with syncromystic clues and symbols. Themes include the myth of Narcissus, the Devil (card) and Kronos, sacred mountains, the Word of God, and the civil war in heaven. Sure to be educational and fun even if you're not up to speed on the show we're examining, but for maximum comprehension, catch up on our whole series!
